definition.name: Night and winter
definition.description: Snowy villages, frosty mornings, moonlit rivers and winter dusks, chosen to stay light enough to read a dashboard over.

works.alt_text: A Norwegian village under deep snow, with houses touched with red, a small arched bridge and frosted birch trees below a blue wooded hill.
A frosted valley in pale blues and pinks, with autumn trees in red and gold and two small figures walking along a path.

placard.title: Valley of the Sédelle at Pont Charraud: White Frost
placard.creator: Armand Guillaumin (French, 1841–1927)

works.alt_text: A woodblock print of a snowy riverbank with pines, stone lanterns and a gate, a deep blue river and white hills beyond under falling snow.

placard.title: Evening Snow at Mimeguri, Eight Views of the Sumida River (Sumidagawa hakkei, Mimeguri bosetsu), from the series "Famous Places in the Eastern Capital (Toto meisho no uchi)"
placard.creator: Utagawa Hiroshige 歌川 広重 (Japanese, 1797-1858)

works.alt_text: Two snow-covered stacks of wheat in a field glowing violet and blue under an orange and pink sunset sky.
A winding river with ice floes between snowy banks, bare trees and a farmhouse in low golden winter sunlight.
A woodblock print of a village at night under heavy snow, with travellers holding hats and umbrellas walking up a white slope.

placard.title: Kanbara: Evening Snow (Kanbara, yoru no yuki), from the series "Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido (Tokaido gojusan tsugi no uchi)," also known as the Hoeido Tokaido
placard.creator: Utagawa Hiroshige 歌川 広重 (Japanese, 1797-1858)

works.alt_text: A waterfall tumbling through snow-covered rocks, with pink mill buildings on the bank and wooded blue hills behind.
A stylised print of grey plovers flying over a teal river that curves between white banks of snow-laden reeds.

placard.title: Plovers Flying Across a River above Snow-Laden Reeds (Fuyu no Kawa), from the series "Worlds of Things (Momoyogusa)"
placard.creator: Kamisaka Sekka (Japanese, 1866-1942, Usudo, Japanese, unknown)

works.alt_text: A French village street after snowfall, with tall pale houses, bare trees and a snowy hillside rising behind.
A blue and white woodblock print of a riverside village and pine trees under snow, a small boat on the pale water below.
A colour print of tall green-trunked beech trees in a snowy wood, with two people carrying bundles of firewood on the right.
A woodblock print of boats on a broad river under a full moon, a castle with tiled roofs on the right and pale fields beyond.

placard.title: Moonlight on the Yodo River (Yodogawa), from the series "Snow, Moon and Flowers (Setsugekka)"
placard.creator: Katsushika Hokusai 葛飾 北斎 (Japanese, 1760–1849)

works.alt_text: A winter marsh at sunset, with a red sun low behind dark bushes, a band of glowing cloud and a river edged with snow.
A photograph of a small white house deep in fresh snow, with a pole in front, frosted trees and a wooded hill behind.

placard.title: First Snow and the Little House
placard.creator: Alfred Stieglitz (American, 1864–1946)
placard.dimensions: Image/paper/first mount: 18.6 × 23.7 cm (7 3/8 × 9 3/8 in.); Second mount: 50.9 × 39 cm (20 1/16 × 15 3/8 in.)

works.alt_text: A woodblock print of a ferry crowded with passengers in straw hats crossing a deep blue river, with snowy pines and houses on the far bank.

placard.title: A Distant View of Snow on the Sumida River in Edo
placard.creator: Ikeda Eisen (Japanese, 1790–1848)

works.alt_text: A crowd of skaters in bright winter coats on a frozen pond, with dark blue wooded hills and a snowy slope behind.
A pen and wash drawing of a Dutch village in winter, with bare trees, cottages, a church spire and a skater by a small arched bridge.

placard.title: Winter Landscape with Skater
placard.creator: Jan van Kessel (Dutch, 1641–1680)
placard.medium: brush and black ink and grey wash over black chalk on cream laid paper; brown ink framing line

works.alt_text: A large silver moon rising behind tall white and black grasses against a soft grey sky.

placard.title: Moon over Musashino, from the series "Worlds of Things (Momoyogusa)"
placard.creator: Kamisaka Sekka (Japanese, 1866-1942)

works.alt_text: An ink painting of a wide river in evening snow, with white hills and pines, sailboats on the grey water, travellers on horseback on the near bank and a poem inscribed above, in a patterned blue mount.

placard.title: Evening Snow Blending River and Sky, from Eight Views of Xiao-Xiang
placard.creator: Tani Bunchō (Japanese, 1763–1841)
placard.medium: album leaf remounted as a hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

works.alt_text: A woodblock print of a ferry with passengers crossing a blue river at dusk, a long wooden bridge and the dark cone of Mount Fuji beyond.

placard.title: Fuji from Ommayagashi with Twilight over Ryogoku Bridge (Ommayagashi yori ryogokubashi sekiyo o miru), from the series "Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjurokkei)"
placard.creator: Katsushika Hokusai 葛飾 北斎 (Japanese, 1760-1849, Publisher: Hibino Yohachi, Japanese, unknown)

works.alt_text: A photograph of a snowy path through a winter field, with bare trees and low hills under a pale grey sky.
A pencil drawing of a white snow-covered building with a small bell tower and a signpost in a snowstorm, with bare trees on a pale hillside.
A pale print of a barge being towed along a snowy riverbank, with willows heavy with snow and white hills behind.

placard.title: Towing a Barge in the Snow, from the album The Silver World
placard.creator: Kitagawa Utamaro 喜多川 歌麿 (Japanese, c.1753-1806)

works.alt_text: A black and white photograph of snowy, glacier-covered mountains beneath a sky of small rippled clouds.

placard.title: Mid Snow and Ice
placard.creator: Alfred Stieglitz (American, 1864–1946)
placard.dimensions: Image/paper/first mount: 15.9 × 21.5 cm (6 5/16 × 8 1/2 in.); Second mount: 27.5 × 34.9 cm (10 7/8 × 13 3/4 in.)
